scope: Period-informed Queens background for November 1928: mixed narrow rowhouses, walk-ups, factories and one commercial height accent. Generic art direction, not a surveyed recreation of a named neighborhood. No new occupied or controlled travel area.

architecture.precedent: 21-21 45th Avenue, Hunters Point; Root and Rust stone Italianate row
architecture.adaptation: Authored dimensions, not a measured replica. Three main storeys over a low basement; narrow three-bay street face, seated stoop and bracketed cornice.

architecture.precedent: 21-42 45th Avenue, Hunters Point; 1889 Queen Anne apartment house
architecture.adaptation: Authored four-storey narrow apartment house. A real three-sided bay, continuous banded cornice and separate entry replace a stretched rectangular module.

architecture.precedent: Linden Court, 84th/85th Streets; Andrew J. Thomas paired garden apartments, 1919–21
architecture.adaptation: Fictional four-storey adaptation of the paired-building/garden vocabulary. A recessed entrance court breaks the street wall; dimensions are authored, not surveyed.
